title: First LedgerCloseMeta v1: generalized transaction set with a classic phase and an empty Soroban phase
why: The ledger after the Protocol 20 upgrade switches to LedgerCloseMeta v1: the transaction set becomes a GeneralizedTransactionSet with two phases, the classic one wrapped in a component with an explicit base fee, the Soroban one empty, and the meta gains ext.v1.sorobanFeeWrite1KB and evictedKeys. Readers still reading tx_set.txs of v0 find no transactions.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger, the first after the Protocol 20 upgrade, captured for this entry.

values.note: The Soroban phase exists and is empty.

known_divergences.detail: A MEMO_TEXT with non-ASCII bytes is written as \xNN escapes (four characters per byte), longer than the schema's maxLength 28 for string<28>; the JSON still reads back to the same bytes.
A MEMO_TEXT with non-ASCII bytes is written as \xNN escapes (four characters per byte), longer than the schema's maxLength 28 for string<28>; the JSON still reads back to the same bytes.

notes: 242 transactions, all in phase 0. The previous ledger is protocol-20/upgrade-ledger-lcm-v0-header-20. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
